Name: Total Item Display
Author: invatorzen
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Total Item Display[/b][/size]
[i]Always know how many you've got.[/i][/center]

[line]
Ever pick something up and wonder [i]"how many of these do I actually have now?"[/i] — but it's buried in your bag, not on the toolbar you have on display?

[b]Total Item Display[/b] adds your running total to the pick-up pop-up in the bottom-left corner.

[center][size=4][b][img width=198]https://i.imgur.com/M6jlLrk.png[/img][/b][/size]
[size=2]had 7 · picked up 3 · now holding 10[/size][/center]
[line]

[size=4][b]✦ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Live totals[/b] — accurate total of how many you have of the item you picked up[/*]
[*][b]Counts your whole bag[/b] — every stack, every quality (configurable)[/*]
[*][b]Stays out of the way[/b] — it only changes what a pop-up says. So it is safe to add or remove anytime during your playthrough.[/*]
[*][b]Display styles  — [/b]three different styles[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]✦ Configuration[/b][/size]
[center]Tweak it in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or edit , or edit , or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:[img width=527]https://i.imgur.com/iuwQyo6.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Format[/b] — Three formats, one that shows the total appended onto the default pop-up. One that displays the number you picked up and total in the pop-up, and one that shows only the total you have. [/*]
[*][b]Stackable items only[/b] — skip tools and rings so you never see a pointless "(1)".[/*]
[*][b]Hide for brand-new items[/b] — only show the total for items you have more than 1 of.[/*]
[*][b]Merge qualities[/b] — count all qualities together, or keep them separate.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]✦ Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — optional, for the settings screen[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Total Item Display
Manifest.Description: When you pick up an item, the bottom-left popup also shows the total number you now have in your inventory in parentheses, e.g. "Wood 3 (16)".
